 │   hjkl ←↓↑→   change objective              │ │   ▌ low                                     │
 │   gg / G      first / last                  │ │   ▌ normal                                  │
 │   ⏎           open it                       │ │   ▌ high                                    │
 │   a           add an objective              │ │   ▌ critical                                │
 │   e           the form                      │ │                                             │
 │   d           delete                        │ │ STALLED — the top right of a card           │
 │   /           search                        │ │   ⊘  blocked   waiting on somebody else     │
 │   ⇥           next tab                      │ │   ◉  watching  handed over, needs a look    │
 │   :           command                       │ │   ‖  paused    waiting on your decision     │
 │   ?           help                          │ │                                             │
 ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯ │ OBJECTIVES                                  │
                                                 │   ▶  active    being worked towards         │
                                                 │   ‖  on-hold   not for now                  │
                                                 │   ✓  reached   done with                    │

                                                 │                                             │

                                                 │   ≡            a description exists         │
